name: m7_du
_doc: M7 deposition/protection gate 'M-DEP' — Du et al. (2025) perforated artificial-reef units around a model monopile (RESEARCH V8, research/15 Benchmark B). Three cases (control / C-AR cubes β=0.1963 / H-AR hemispheres β=0.3125) as sub-grid porous shells (holes ~1-2 cells ⇒ thin-screen model k=1/β²−1). QUALITATIVE-COMPARATIVE gate: the porous units must reduce scour vs control and trap sand; absolute S/D is expected low (the SL-solver HSV under-resolution quantified by gate_M6) and its calibration is supervised (MH). Run: build/Release/scour_m7_gate.exe configs/m7_du.json [--U 0.30] [--quick] [--only control|car|har] [--csv out.csv].
